summary: Partial-width signed integers were zero-extended, so decoding byte 0xd6 returned 214 instead of -42. The fix sign-extends unsigned decoding results for both byte orders. This reversal restores only the original get_int implementation; test_get_int, added by the fix in tests/test_buf.rs, detects it at its first assertion. Both regions occur exactly once in their respective Git objects. No builds or tests were run.
